sources.title: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
claims_used_as_reference: A Loop Kernel is described as Observe -> Diagnose -> Propose -> Validate -> Execute -> Select -> Export.
Data-RSI, Harness-RSI and Model-RSI are typed operators with disjoint write surfaces; the paper keeps verifier, evaluator, gate and ledger outside those surfaces.
Horizontal orchestration composes operators while vertical optimization rewrites an operator policy; these are distinct deltas.
The paper distinguishes an amplifier of existing latent competence from a source of genuinely external information.
The paper states that fixed measurement surfaces must not be quietly rewritten to raise a promotion score.
not_adopted: Any paper benchmark result as evidence about Ignition

sources.title: RSI-Harness / RSIH
implemented_mechanisms_used_as_reference: A versioned Genome bundles a harness configuration across named components.
Component field ownership is mutually exclusive and out-of-bounds writes fail at load time.
The harness-rsi Genome reads observable session history and generates a deliverable Genome only after user confirmation.
Configuration is a patch with inherit-by-default semantics rather than a hidden replacement.
